name: check-bindings-3
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json, hashlib, os, re
d=json.load(open("literal-bindings.json"))
want=re.findall(r'\b\d{6}\b',open("reservation.json").read())
got=[b["id"] for b in d["bindings"]]
print("count",d["count"],"ids_match",got==want,"n",len(got))
print("file_sha256",hashlib.sha256(open("literal-bindings.json","rb").read()).hexdigest(),"bytes",os.path.getsize("literal-bindings.json"))
print("min_statement_len",min(len(b["statement"]) for b in d["bindings"]))
print("empty_ids",[b["id"] for b in d["bindings"] if not b["statement"].strip()])
print("chunks",sorted(set(b["chunk"] for b in d["bindings"])))
print("titles_present",all(b["title"] for b in d["bindings"]))
print("sample",[(b["id"],b["line_1based"],b["decoded_statement_len"]) for b in d["bindings"][:4]])
